about: Jarvis country calendar (#2989): the dates that are not public holidays (those come from Nager.Date). cc is a country, a list, a region below, or ALL (every target market). rule recurs each year: MM-DD, 'nth weekday of month' (1st-5th or last), 'easter', 'day N' (day of the year), each with an optional +N/-N days; date is a one-off YYYY-MM-DD; dates overrides a year with the organiser's announced start. days is how long it lasts, lead how many days ahead Jarvis warns (the settings' warn days when larger), do what Jarvis proposes: campaign (prospects and a themed sequence, Marketing), post (a social post, Social hub), routine (an outreach routine, Marketing) or nothing. Approximate rules say so in why; organisers confirm exact dates a few weeks ahead.

dates.name: Black Friday
dates.why: The biggest online sales weekend: retailers freeze site changes and fix checkout, speed and accessibility in the weeks before.
dates.action: Queue retail and e-commerce prospects 3-4 weeks ahead with an 'is your checkout ready for Black Friday' sequence.

dates.name: Cyber Monday
dates.why: The online half of the Black Friday weekend; slow or broken shops lose the day's sales.
dates.action: Post a short 'what breaks on Cyber Monday' checklist with a free URL review link.

dates.name: El Buen Fin
dates.why: Mexico's national sales weekend (13-17 Nov 2026, official rules); shops register and advertise from 1 November.
dates.action: Queue MX retail prospects and a themed sequence: 'your Buen Fin landing pages, checked before the weekend'.

dates.name: Hot Sale México
dates.why: AMVO's online sale (25 May-2 Jun in 2026); the rule approximates the start until AMVO announces it.
dates.action: Queue MX e-commerce prospects a month ahead with a Hot Sale readiness review.

dates.name: Hot Sale Argentina
dates.why: CACE's online sale (11-13 May in 2026); approximate until CACE announces it.
dates.action: Queue AR e-commerce prospects with a Hot Sale readiness review.

dates.name: CyberMonday Argentina
dates.why: CACE's November online sale (2-4 Nov in 2026); approximate until CACE announces it.
dates.action: Queue AR e-commerce prospects in early October.

dates.name: CyberDay Chile
dates.why: The Cámara de Comercio de Santiago's June sale (1-3 Jun in 2026); approximate until the CCS announces it.
dates.action: Queue CL e-commerce prospects with a CyberDay readiness review.

dates.name: CyberMonday Chile
dates.why: The CCS October sale (5-7 Oct in 2026); approximate until announced.
dates.action: Queue CL e-commerce prospects in early September.

dates.name: Hot Sale Colombia (March)
dates.why: The CCCE online sale that replaced Cyberlunes (16-20 Mar in 2026); approximate until announced.
dates.action: Queue CO e-commerce prospects with a Hot Sale readiness review.

dates.name: Hot Sale Colombia (October)
dates.why: The CCCE second online sale (19-23 Oct in 2026); approximate until announced.
dates.action: Queue CO e-commerce prospects in September.

dates.name: Cyber Wow Perú (April)
dates.why: IAB Perú's online sale (20-23 Apr in 2026); approximate until announced.
dates.action: Queue PE e-commerce prospects with a Cyber Wow readiness review.

dates.name: Cyber Wow Perú (July)
dates.why: IAB Perú's mid-year sale (13-16 Jul in 2026), next to Fiestas Patrias.
dates.action: Queue PE e-commerce prospects in June.

dates.name: Cyber Wow Perú (November)
dates.why: IAB Perú's November sale (2-5 Nov in 2026).
dates.action: Queue PE e-commerce prospects in early October.

dates.name: Dia do Consumidor
dates.why: Brazil's March consumer week, the first big e-commerce date of the year.
dates.action: Queue BR e-commerce prospects with a Portuguese readiness review.

dates.name: Singles' Day (11.11)
dates.why: Marketplaces push 11.11 sales worldwide; it opens the November shopping season.
dates.action: Post a 'November traffic is coming: is your site ready' note.

dates.name: Christmas shopping peak
dates.why: The last ten days before Christmas: shops change nothing, offices slow down; work has to be sold before.
dates.action: Close review deals before mid-December; queue retail prospects early December at the latest.

dates.name: Boxing Day sales
dates.why: Year-end sales in English-speaking markets.
dates.action: Post a short accessibility tip for sale pages.

dates.name: Rebajas de enero
dates.why: Spain's winter sales start after Reyes (7 January).
dates.action: Queue ES retail prospects in mid-December.

dates.name: Soldes d'hiver
dates.why: France's legal winter sales (four weeks from the second Wednesday of January; approximate in some years).
dates.action: Queue FR retail prospects in mid-December.

dates.name: Mother's Day
dates.why: One of the strongest retail dates of the year.
dates.action: Post a themed accessibility tip for gift and checkout pages.

dates.name: Día de las Madres
dates.why: Fixed on 10 May; the strongest retail date before the Hot Sale.
dates.action: Post a themed tip for gift and checkout pages.

dates.name: Día de la Madre
dates.why: First Sunday of May in Spain and Portugal.
dates.action: Post a themed tip for gift pages.

dates.name: Fête des mères
dates.why: Last Sunday of May (France moves it a week when Pentecost falls that day).
dates.action: Post a themed tip for gift pages.

dates.name: Día de la Madre
dates.why: Third Sunday of October in Argentina.
dates.action: Post a themed tip for gift pages.

dates.name: Mothering Sunday
dates.why: Three weeks before Easter in the UK and Ireland.
dates.action: Post a themed tip for gift pages.

dates.name: Fall semester starts
dates.why: US and Canadian universities start late August; web, IT and accessibility offices plan and buy before students arrive.
dates.action: University outreach 3-4 weeks before: admissions, LMS and library pages checked for WCAG 2.1 AA.

dates.name: Spring semester starts
dates.why: Second term in US and Canadian universities.
dates.action: University outreach in early December, before the break.

dates.name: Autumn term starts
dates.why: UK and Irish universities start late September; Freshers' week traffic peaks on course and admissions pages.
dates.action: University outreach in August.

dates.name: Curso universitario empieza
dates.why: Spanish universities start mid-September; TVET (FP) centres the same week.
dates.action: University and FP outreach in late August.

dates.name: Segundo cuatrimestre
dates.why: Second semester in Spanish universities, right after January exams.
dates.action: University outreach late January, after exams.

dates.name: January exams
dates.why: University staff are taken up by exams; replies slow down.
dates.action: Keep university sends light until February.

dates.name: Rentrée universitaire
dates.why: French and Belgian universities start mid-September.
dates.action: University outreach in late August (offices reopen after mid-August).

dates.name: Inizio anno accademico
dates.why: Italian universities start lectures around 1 October.
dates.action: University outreach in September.

dates.name: Wintersemester lectures start
dates.why: German and Austrian lectures start mid-October.
dates.action: University outreach in September.

dates.name: Sommersemester lectures start
dates.why: German and Austrian summer semester lectures start mid-April.
dates.action: University outreach in March.

dates.name: Autumn semester starts
dates.why: Swiss universities start mid-September.
dates.action: University outreach in August.

dates.name: Semestre agosto-diciembre
dates.why: Mexican universities (UNAM, Tec) start in August; admissions pages peak in July.
dates.action: University outreach in July.

dates.name: Semestre enero-mayo
dates.why: Second Mexican semester.
dates.action: University outreach early January.

dates.name: Primer semestre (universidades)
dates.why: Colombian universities and SENA start the year late January-early February.
dates.action: University and TVET outreach in mid-January, when offices reopen.

dates.name: Segundo semestre (universidades)
dates.why: Colombian universities start the second semester late July-early August.
dates.action: University and TVET outreach in July.

dates.name: Vacaciones intersemestrales
dates.why: Mid-year university break; offices slow down.
dates.action: Keep university sends light until mid-July.

dates.name: Semestre académico I
dates.why: Peruvian universities start late March.
dates.action: University outreach early March.

dates.name: First semester starts (southern hemisphere)
dates.why: Universities in Argentina, Chile, Brazil, Uruguay and Paraguay start in March after the summer break.
dates.action: University outreach from mid-February.

dates.name: Second semester starts (southern hemisphere)
dates.why: Second semester after the July winter break.
dates.action: University outreach early July.

dates.name: Semester 1 starts
dates.why: Australian and New Zealand universities start late February.
dates.action: University outreach in late January.

dates.name: Semester 2 starts
dates.why: Second semester in Australia and New Zealand.
dates.action: University outreach in early July.

dates.name: Academic year starts
dates.why: South African universities start in February.
dates.action: University outreach in January.

dates.name: Academic year starts
dates.why: Most Indian universities start in July-August.
dates.action: University outreach in June.

dates.name: Academic year starts
dates.why: Most Philippine universities start in August.
dates.action: University outreach in July.

dates.name: Year-end university break
dates.why: Universities close from about 19 December to 10 January; email to campus sits unread.
dates.action: Pause or slow university sequences; resume in the second week of January.

dates.name: Summer university break
dates.why: Southern-hemisphere universities run skeleton crews from late December to mid-February.
dates.action: Move university sequences to the second half of February.

dates.name: US federal fiscal year ends
dates.why: Federal agencies and grant-funded universities spend what is left in August and September.
dates.action: Pitch audits to federal-funded buyers in early August.

dates.name: Fiscal year ends (30 June)
dates.why: Most US states and public universities, and Australia, New Zealand and Kenya's governments, close the year on 30 June; leftover budget is spent in May-June.
dates.action: Offer audits that fit leftover budget from mid-May.

dates.name: Fiscal year ends (31 March)
dates.why: UK, India, Canada and South Africa's public sector (and many companies) close the year on 31 March; leftover budget goes in February-March.
dates.action: Offer audits that fit leftover budget from mid-February.

dates.name: Budget year ends (31 December)
dates.why: Calendar-year budgets close: leftover money is spent in November-December and next year's plan is approved in Q4.
dates.action: Offer a year-end audit that fits leftover budget, and ask for a line in next year's plan.

dates.name: European Accessibility Act anniversary
dates.why: The EAA (Directive (EU) 2019/882) applies since 28 June 2025: e-commerce, banking and transport services must be accessible.
dates.action: EAA anniversary post, and an accessibility check offer to EU e-commerce prospects.

dates.name: ADA Title II web rule: governments of 50,000+
dates.why: State and local governments of 50,000+ people must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (moved from 24 Apr 2026 by DOJ's interim rule of 20 Apr 2026); public universities count.
dates.action: Queue US public universities, community colleges and city sites with a WCAG 2.1 AA audit offer.

dates.name: ADA Title II web rule: smaller governments
dates.why: Public entities under 50,000 people and special districts must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (moved from 26 Apr 2027).
dates.action: Queue small-town, school-district and special-district sites.

dates.name: HHS Section 504 web rule: recipients under 15 staff
dates.why: HHS-funded recipients with fewer than 15 employees must make web content and apps accessible (larger ones since May 2026).
dates.action: Queue health and social-service providers with an accessibility audit offer.

dates.name: Chile data protection law (Ley 21.719) in force
dates.why: Ley 21.719 applies from 1 December 2026 unless the postponement bill (Boletín 18.623-07, to 15 Oct 2027) is published first.
dates.action: Offer CL organisations a privacy and consent review of their forms and cookies.

dates.name: India DPDP: consent manager rules apply
dates.why: Phase two of the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025.
dates.action: Nothing to sell yet; the main deadline is 13 May 2027.

dates.name: India DPDP: core obligations apply
dates.why: Notice, consent, security safeguards and breach rules of the DPDP Act apply 18 months after the Rules (13 Nov 2025).
dates.action: Offer IN organisations a consent and privacy-notice review of their sites.

dates.name: EU AI Act: AI-generated content labelling
dates.why: Machine-readable labelling of AI-generated content applies (Digital Omnibus, Regulation (EU) 2026/1744).
dates.action: Worth a post if a client site uses AI-generated media.

dates.name: EU AI Act: stand-alone high-risk systems
dates.why: High-risk (Annex III) obligations apply, postponed from 2 Aug 2026; includes AI used in education admissions and grading.
dates.action: Relevant to universities using AI in admissions: mention in university outreach.

dates.name: GDPR anniversary
dates.why: GDPR has applied since 25 May 2018.
dates.action: Post a cookie-banner and form-privacy tip.

dates.name: Data Privacy Day
dates.why: Data Protection Day (28 January) in Europe and beyond.
dates.action: Post a privacy check tip with a free URL review link.

dates.name: Safer Internet Day
dates.why: Global awareness day; schools and universities share content.
dates.action: Post a site safety tip aimed at schools.

dates.name: Global Accessibility Awareness Day
dates.why: The accessibility community's big day; prospects are listening.
dates.action: GAAD post and a short accessibility-audit offer to warm leads.

dates.name: MSME Day
dates.why: UN Micro-, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises Day.
dates.action: Queue SME prospects with a 'your site in 10 minutes' review offer.

dates.name: Day of the Programmer
dates.why: The 256th day of the year (13 Sep, 12 Sep in leap years).
dates.action: Post a QA tip for developers.

dates.name: Día del Ingeniero
dates.why: Colombia's engineers' day.
dates.action: Post a QA tip in Spanish.

dates.name: Día del Ingeniero
dates.why: Mexico's engineers' day.
dates.action: Post a QA tip in Spanish.

dates.name: Día de la Ingeniería
dates.why: Argentina's engineering day.
dates.action: Post a QA tip in Spanish.

dates.name: Cybersecurity Awareness Month
dates.why: October is cybersecurity month in the US and EU.
dates.action: Post TLS, headers and mail (SPF/DMARC) tips from the URL review.

dates.name: World Usability Day
dates.why: Global usability day; UX teams share and buy.
dates.action: Post a usability finding from a recent review.

dates.name: World Quality Day
dates.why: Quality professionals' day: the QA in QA Lab.
dates.action: Post a QA Lab or URL review tip.

dates.name: International Day of Persons with Disabilities
dates.why: UN day (3 December); accessibility is on the agenda.
dates.action: Accessibility post and a WCAG audit offer to universities and public bodies.

dates.name: CSUN Assistive Technology Conference
dates.why: The largest accessibility conference; approximate week.
dates.action: Post about accessibility findings that week.

dates.name: Google I/O
dates.why: Search and Chrome changes are announced; approximate date.
dates.action: Watch for Core Web Vitals or Lighthouse changes to mention in reviews.

dates.name: Apple WWDC
dates.why: Safari and iOS accessibility changes are announced; approximate date.
dates.action: Check Safari changes that affect the review.

dates.name: Web Summit Lisbon
dates.why: Europe's largest tech conference; approximate week.
dates.action: Post on the week's themes; Portuguese startups are listening.

dates.name: Ramadan
dates.why: Shorter working hours; decisions slow down. Dates can move a day with the moon.
dates.action: Lighten sends to these countries and avoid launches.

dates.name: Eid al-Fitr
dates.why: End of Ramadan; offices close. Dates can move a day with the moon.
dates.action: Hold sends to these countries for two days.

dates.name: Eid al-Adha
dates.why: Offices close. Dates can move a day with the moon.
dates.action: Hold sends to these countries for two days.
